summary: Read two words that contain only lowercase English letters. Each word has length from 1 to 105. Two kinds of edits are allowed any number of times, and either word may be edited. The first edit swaps two characters that already occur. The second edit picks two characters that already occur, replaces every sighting of the first with the second, and at the same time replaces every sighting of the second with the first. Decide whether some edits can make both words into one identical word. Write true when they can, and write false when they cannot.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
